main_text.p: nâ, quod dicere consuevimus, clarius apparet.

Neque in exercenda ista militia, & virulenta lingua atq; stylí tela in Dn. Iesum, aeterni Patris Filium aeternum, dirigendo, postremus fuit La-Lælius Socinus.lius Socinus Senensis, Mariani Iurisconsulti F. Tiguri diu versatus, ac ibidem tandem etiam mortuus, homo ingenii plane Academici, & incredibiliter ad contradicendum ac varios nectendum [illegible, ~5 letters] comparatus, nec non egregius dissimulator, ita quidem, ut quid is animo meditaretur suo, quod, inquam, perditissimus Samosatenianus & Arianus esset, haeresibus hoc genus aliis pernitiosissimis laboraret, nonnisi post illius mortem cognosceretur, postquam in Ecclesiis Evangelicis peragrandis Melanchthoni, Calvino, Camerario turpiter impofuisset, insignis & astutissimus hypocrita. Nam & sub Martini Bellii nomine fictitio, ὀρθοδοξίαν[?] insidiose oppugnavit, eumque Serveti, Castellionis, Ochini deniq; furoribus fuisse, compertum est. In Samosateni partes clam eum transiisse, argumento est, quod verbum Dei, ac praesertim primum Evangelii Johannis caput adeo veteratorie & plane versute depravavit, ut videatur omnium ejus corruptorum impietatem longe superasse.

Iisdem annis Franciscus Stancarus Franciscus Stancarus.(Mantuanus, homo pestilentissimus, virulentis dogmatibus Poloniam inficere cepit, asserendo, Christum non esse, nisi secundum humanam naturam, Mediatorem; Arianismi insimulans, quotcunque illi dicerent,

page.notes: The word before "comparatus" in the line after "ad contradicendum" is damaged and cannot be read; marked as illegible. The Greek word "ὀρθοδοξίαν" is partly worn and uncertain. The "(" before "Mantuanus" is a doubtful character. "Mariani" is doubtful, and the scan shows it clearly enough to copy as printed. The last line, "dicerent,", is short and continues onto the next page. Printed spellings such as "impofuisset", "ejus" and "Johannis" are kept as printed.
